supervisor.value: Strongly encouraged to list faculty members of interest in personal statement.
supervisor.quote: Visit the department research page and list a few Physics & Astronomy Dept. faculty you are interested in working with.

funding.value: TAs provided for up to two years, after which students typically find RA employment.
funding.quote: Depending upon budgetary restrictions, we provide TAs for up to two years pending continued satisfactory performance of teaching/grading duties. After the first two years, students typically find employment as Research Assistants (RAs) with one of our faculty.

entry_route.quote: Previous Education: Earned degree that is the equivalent to a U.S. Bachelor degree.
